# Vanilla hosting loop

Connect catalog authorization and immutable releases to a real player-side executor. A room has one fenced host lease, an authenticated outbound tunnel and a canonical cloud world snapshot. The executor restores before starting, checkpoints on cadence and on clean stop, and releases only after successful world commit.

The agreed first delivery is vanilla only, real local Java process, center relay address and graceful host handover. Microsoft app approval remains separate. Existing catalog data is preserved.
